''See also: [[Naraka Incarnation Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Naraka]] [[Incarnation]] is a powerful force of nature associated with the Cavern of Flame, a territory representing law and order. While these entities are inherently noble creatures capable of immense power, spending too much time in the world causes them to descend into a state of madness similar to rabid animals. Becoming an [[Incarnation of Naraka]] is a difficult process that requires an individual to simultaneously desire justice while fleeing from it. The [[Naraka]] [[Incarnation]] possesses a distinct, monstrous appearance characterized by skin made of volcanic stone and ash, hair composed of living flame, and glowing ember-like eyes. It is a massive entity, standing approximately ten feet tall with a large lizard-like tail and the ability to manipulate intense fire. It demonstrates significant regenerative capabilities, such as regrowing severed limbs from ash. In combat, it utilizes a massive hammer and can release devastating waves of heat. Driven by its nature to uphold moral principles and seek retribution, the [[Naraka]] [[Incarnation]] acts as a judge. Upon its release from being held captive by [[Damasca]] for three centuries, it caused widespread devastation, destroying parts of [[Bel Calem]] and the village of [[Myria]]. Its actions are viewed as a form of natural balance, punishing nations for their crimes through destruction and judgment.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The [[Naraka]] [[Incarnation]] exists without freedom within a prison located in [[Malachi's realm]]. Standing nearly ten feet tall, this entity possesses a face sculpted from hardened volcanic stone and crusty ash, complemented by hair made of flame and orange eyes that glow like hot coals. Its physical form includes bat-like wings of ash, a red-scaled draconic tail, and the ability to regrow a severed hand from ash. In combat, it wields a massive hammer featuring an obsidian shaft and a head of flame, while also possessing the power to blast intense waves of fire from its palm. The creature's presence is marked by a voice resembling an angry volcano and a chuckle like gargling boulders, though its body ultimately dissolves into ash upon death.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Upon its release, the [[Naraka]] [[Incarnation]] tore [[Bel Calem]] to pieces and set much of both [[Bel Calem]] and [[Myria]] ablaze. The entity's destructive path continued as it burned down a village, and on one occasion, it leveled an entire city block in [[Bel Calem]]. Ultimately, the process of becoming a [[Naraka]] [[Incarnation]] is noted to be more difficult than becoming an [[Elysia Incarnation]].}}
